activity_summary: Simon Waterson brought you to the ordinary and left. Daniel told you he had come to Shoreditch last week, in a plain cloak, to see the king, and that he still mistrusts a penny yard. The boy speaking the Queen's sorrow made his stanzas seem cold marble. You said the stanzas had taught you where to look. The Civil Wars cost two shillings in April. You talked of the second Richard as a joint in a piece of work, where the chronicle bends and where the play cheats. There was no edge. The jaw managed the wardens and you declined the crust. You parted at Paul's Chain.
